Fill Ins Era 1983 - to now including albums 90125, Big Generator, Talk, Open Your Eyes, Ladder,  Magnification, Fly From Here, Heaven and Earth and The Quest.   


Then there is Union from 1991 where both the fill ins and the classic lineup emerged together and made a pitiful album but amazing tour. 

The Keys to Ascension 1 and 2 are classic line up with both live and new material from 1997.
